name: step4_item_agg
hypothesis: Video-side historical rates vary WITHIN a user list, so unlike user-side features they can move the within-user order. Untested by the organizers.

name: step5_cross_agg
hypothesis: user x item crosses (author affinity, tag affinity, duration-vs-preference) are the only way user information can affect a within-user ranking.

name: step6_dur_feats
hypothesis: long_view is watch time relative to duration, so duration bias is structural. Cheap proxy for debiasing: log duration and duration rank within the user list.

name: step7_user_agg
hypothesis: DECISIVE TEST. User-level rates are CONSTANT within a user, so they cannot shift the order directly and can only act as tree gates. If the isolated delta is under 0.001, delete them from the action space.

name: step4_item_agg_LOO
hypothesis: Video-side historical rates vary WITHIN a user list, so unlike user-side features they can move the within-user order. Untested by the organizers. Now with leave-one-out on train rows.

name: step5_cross_agg_LOO
hypothesis: user x item crosses (author affinity, tag affinity, duration-vs-preference) are the only way user information can affect a within-user ranking.

name: step6_dur_feats_LOO
hypothesis: long_view is watch time relative to duration, so duration bias is structural. Cheap proxy for debiasing: log duration and duration rank within the user list.

name: step7_user_agg_LOO
hypothesis: DECISIVE TEST. User-level rates are CONSTANT within a user, so they cannot shift the order directly and can only act as tree gates. If the isolated delta is under 0.001, delete them from the action space.

name: step8_aggs_only_no_ids
hypothesis: video_id is a 7.5k-level categorical the tree can fit directly, so a train-window video rate may be strictly redundant with it. Drop the IDs and keep only the aggregates: if this holds up, they encode the same thing.

name: step8_base5_no_user_id_proxy
hypothesis: User-level rates are within-user constants. With OOF encoding, do they now earn their place as tree gates?

name: step9a_full_reference
hypothesis: Reference: base5+duration+dur_feats.

name: step9a_drop_user_id
hypothesis: user_id is a within-user CONSTANT: it cannot reorder a list directly, only gate. At 26,210 levels with max_cat_threshold=64 it is a prime overfitting surface. Drop it.

name: step9a_drop_author_id
hypothesis: author_id is largely collinear with video_id. Drop it.

name: step9a_drop_both_ids
hypothesis: Drop user_id and author_id together.
